         <h2 class="project-title">E-commerce Search &amp; Learning to Rank</h2>
         <p class="project-subhead">BM25 · Pairwise Ranking · NDCG@10</p>

         <div class="nb-container"><div class="cell border-box-sizing text_cell rendered" id="cell-id=135838f1"><div class="inner_cell">
<div class="text_cell_render border-box-sizing rendered_html">
<p><strong>Track:</strong> Machine Learning / Search<br/>
<strong>Research / product question:</strong> Can we rank relevant e-commerce products above distractors for unseen queries?</p>
<p><strong>Learning outcome:</strong> Manual BM25, NDCG@K, query-group splits, pairwise RankNet-style learning and tuning.</p>
<p><strong>Workflow:</strong> Data-generating process → raw-data audit → leakage-safe features → from-scratch baseline → model selection / hyperparameter tuning → held-out evaluation → failure analysis.</p>
<blockquote>
<p><strong>Synthetic-data disclosure:</strong> All records and outcomes are created in this notebook; they do not describe real customers or credit decisions. Ground truth is constructed for teaching. Numerical results are illustrative of this simulator, not estimates of real-world business impact.</p>
</blockquote>
<p><strong>Reproducibility:</strong> Random seeds are fixed. Run cells top-to-bottom. Install packages from the project-level <code>requirements.txt</code>. CPU execution is supported; deep-learning examples deliberately use small models.</p>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="cell border-box-sizing text_cell rendered" id="cell-id=35172597"><div class="inner_cell">
<div class="text_cell_render border-box-sizing rendered_html">
<blockquote>
<p><strong>Portfolio standard:</strong> fully reproducible, synthetic educational data · explicit evaluation protocol · plots and failure analysis · no claims of production accuracy.</p>
</blockquote>
<p>We split by <strong>query</strong>, not individual query–document pairs. Graded <strong>relevance labels</strong> are simulated ground truth; clicks are logged separately and are position-biased. A hand-built synonym dictionary is used as domain knowledge, not as a target label.</p>
</div>
</div>
</div>

<div class="input_area">

<div class="text_cell_render border-box-sizing rendered_html">
<h2 id="1.-Simulate-query%E2%80%93product-judgments">1. Simulate query–product judgments</h2><p>Product relevance is known in the simulator, while click labels are biased by position. <strong>We evaluate on explicit relevance</strong>, not biased click labels. Products are intentionally short and ambiguous.</p>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="cell border-box-sizing code_cell rendered" id="cell-id=f5332180">
<details class="code-block" open=""><summary>Python source · Cell 2</summary><div class="input">
<div class="inner_cell">
<div class="input_area">
<div class="highlight hl-ipython3"><pre><span></span><span class="c1"># Generated product relevance is the offline evaluation target; clicks contain position bias.</span>
<span class="kn">from</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nn">collections</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kn">import</span> <span class="n">Counter</span>
<span class="kn">from</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nn">sklearn.metrics</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kn">import</span> <span class="n">ndcg_score</span>
<span class="kn">from</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nn">sklearn.linear_model</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kn">import</span> <span class="n">LogisticRegression</span>
<span class="n">categories</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="p">{</span><span class="s1">'laptop'</span><span class="p">:[</span><span class="s1">'laptop'</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="s1">'notebook'</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="s1">'computer'</span><span class="p">],</span> <span class="s1">'headphones'</span><span class="p">:[</span><span class="s1">'headphones'</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="s1">'headset'</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="s1">'earbuds'</span><span class="p">],</span> <span class="s1">'camera'</span><span class="p">:[</span><span class="s1">'camera'</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="s1">'photography'</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="s1">'dslr'</span><span class="p">],</span> <span class="s1">'coffee'</span><span class="p">:[</span><span class="s1">'coffee'</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="s1">'espresso'</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="s1">'beans'</span><span class="p">],</span> <span class="s1">'shoes'</span><span class="p">:[</span><span class="s1">'shoes'</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="s1">'sneakers'</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="s1">'running'</span><span class="p">]}</span>
<span class="n">products</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="p">[]</span>
<span class="k">for</span> <span class="n">cat</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="n">words</span> <span class="ow">in</span> <span class="n">categories</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">items</span><span class="p">():</span>
 <span class="k">for</span> <span class="n">i</span> <span class="ow">in</span> <span class="nb">range</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="mi">30</span><span class="p">):</span>
    <span class="n">products</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">append</span><span class="p">({</span><span class="s1">'product_id'</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="sa">f</span><span class="s1">'</span><span class="si">{</span><span class="n">cat</span><span class="si">}</span><span class="s1">_</span><span class="si">{</span><span class="n">i</span><span class="si">}</span><span class="s1">'</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="s1">'category'</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="n">cat</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="s1">'title'</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="sa">f</span><span class="s1">'</span><span class="si">{</span><span class="n">rng</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">choice</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">words</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="si">}</span><span class="s1"> </span><span class="si">{</span><span class="n">rng</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">choice</span><span class="p">([</span><span class="s2">"pro"</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="s2">"budget"</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="s2">"wireless"</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="s2">"premium"</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="s2">"lightweight"</span><span class="p">])</span><span class="si">}</span><span class="s1"> model </span><span class="si">{</span><span class="n">i</span><span class="si">}</span><span class="s1">'</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="s1">'quality'</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="n">rng</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">uniform</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="mf">.05</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="mi">1</span><span class="p">),</span><span class="s1">'price'</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="n">rng</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">uniform</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="mi">20</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="mi">450</span><span class="p">)})</span>
<span class="n">products</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="n">pd</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">DataFrame</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">products</span><span class="p">)</span>
<span class="n">queries</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="p">[]</span>
<span class="k">for</span> <span class="n">cat</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="n">words</span> <span class="ow">in</span> <span class="n">categories</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">items</span><span class="p">():</span>
 <span class="k">for</span> <span class="n">i</span> <span class="ow">in</span> <span class="nb">range</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="mi">42</span><span class="p">):</span>
    <span class="n">q</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="sa">f</span><span class="s1">'</span><span class="si">{</span><span class="n">rng</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">choice</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">words</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="si">}</span><span class="s1"> </span><span class="si">{</span><span class="n">rng</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">choice</span><span class="p">([</span><span class="s2">"best"</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="s2">"affordable"</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="s2">"premium"</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="s2">"lightweight"</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="s2">"wireless"</span><span class="p">])</span><span class="si">}</span><span class="s1">'</span>
    <span class="n">queries</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">append</span><span class="p">({</span><span class="s1">'query_id'</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="nb">len</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">queries</span><span class="p">),</span><span class="s1">'query'</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="n">q</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="s1">'intent'</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="n">cat</span><span class="p">})</span>
<span class="n">queries</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="n">pd</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">DataFrame</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">queries</span><span class="p">)</span>
<span class="n">rows</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="p">[]</span>
<span class="k">for</span> <span class="n">q</span> <span class="ow">in</span> <span class="n">queries</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">itertuples</span><span class="p">():</span>
 <span class="n">subset</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="n">products</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">sample</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="mi">25</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="n">random_state</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="nb">int</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">q</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">query_id</span><span class="o">+</span><span class="mi">100</span><span class="p">))</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">copy</span><span class="p">()</span>
 <span class="c1"># Inject relevant items to avoid empty-positive ranking groups.</span>
 <span class="n">subextra</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="n">products</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="n">products</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">category</span><span class="o">==</span><span class="n">q</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">intent</span><span class="p">]</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">sample</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="mi">7</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="n">random_state</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="nb">int</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">q</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">query_id</span><span class="o">+</span><span class="mi">10</span><span class="p">))</span>
 <span class="n">subset</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="n">pd</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">concat</span><span class="p">([</span><span class="n">subset</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="n">subextra</span><span class="p">])</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">drop_duplicates</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s1">'product_id'</span><span class="p">)</span>
 <span class="k">for</span> <span class="n">pos</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="n">p</span> <span class="ow">in</span> <span class="nb">enumerate</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">subset</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">itertuples</span><span class="p">(),</span><span class="mi">1</span><span class="p">):</span>
    <span class="n">rel</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="nb">int</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">p</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">category</span><span class="o">==</span><span class="n">q</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">intent</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="o">*</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="mi">2</span><span class="o">+</span><span class="nb">int</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">p</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">quality</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="mf">.7</span><span class="p">))</span>
    <span class="c1"># Simulated biased impressions: position can overwhelm relevance in raw clicks.</span>
    <span class="n">click_prob</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="mf">.04</span><span class="o">+</span><span class="mf">.20</span><span class="o">*</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">rel</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="o">+</span><span class="mf">.22</span><span class="o">*</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">rel</span><span class="o">==</span><span class="mi">3</span><span class="p">))</span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n">np</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">exp</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="mf">.055</span><span class="o">*</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">pos</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="mi">1</span><span class="p">))</span>
    <span class="n">rows</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">append</span><span class="p">((</span><span class="n">q</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">query_id</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="n">q</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">query</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="n">q</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">intent</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="n">p</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">product_id</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="n">p</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">title</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="n">p</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">quality</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="n">p</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">price</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="n">pos</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="n">rel</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="nb">int</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">rng</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">random</span><span class="p">()</span><span class="o">&lt;</span><span class="n">click_prob</span><span class="p">)))</span>
<span class="n">df</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="n">pd</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">DataFrame</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">rows</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="n">columns</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s1">'qid'</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="s1">'query'</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="s1">'intent'</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="s1">'product'</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="s1">'title'</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="s1">'quality'</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="s1">'price'</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="s1">'logged_position'</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="s1">'relevance'</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="s1">'click'</span><span class="p">])</span>
<span class="nb">print</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">df</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">head</span><span class="p">()</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">to_string</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">index</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="kc">False</span><span class="p">));</span><span class="nb">print</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s1">'Rows'</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="nb">len</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">df</span><span class="p">),</span><span class="s1">'groups'</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="n">df</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">qid</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">nunique</span><span class="p">())</span>
</pre></div>
</div>
</div>
</div></details>

<div class="cell border-box-sizing text_cell rendered" id="cell-id=1705b382"><div class="inner_cell">
<div class="text_cell_render border-box-sizing rendered_html">
<h2 id="2.-Implement-BM25-manually">2. Implement BM25 manually</h2><p>BM25 uses term frequency, inverse document frequency and length normalization. The index is built only from the available product catalog; relevance judgments are never used to form lexical features.</p>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="cell border-box-sizing code_cell rendered" id="cell-id=b1e62bfc">
<details class="code-block"><summary>Python source · Cell 3</summary><div class="input">
<div class="inner_cell">
<div class="input_area">
<div class="highlight hl-ipython3"><pre><span></span><span class="c1"># Implement BM25 from the token/document frequency statistics.</span>
<span class="kn">import</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nn">math</span><span class="o">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nn">re</span>
<span class="kn">from</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nn">sklearn.preprocessing</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kn">import</span> <span class="n">StandardScaler</span>
<span class="k">def</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf">toks</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">s</span><span class="p">):</span><span class="k">return</span> <span class="n">re</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">findall</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="sa">r</span><span class="s1">'[a-z0-9]+'</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="n">s</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">lower</span><span class="p">())</span>
<span class="n">corpus</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="n">toks</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">x</span><span class="p">)</span> <span class="k">for</span> <span class="n">x</span> <span class="ow">in</span> <span class="n">products</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">title</span><span class="p">]</span>
<span class="n">D</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="nb">len</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">corpus</span><span class="p">);</span><span class="n">docfreq</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="n">Counter</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">t</span> <span class="k">for</span> <span class="n">doc</span> <span class="ow">in</span> <span class="n">corpus</span> <span class="k">for</span> <span class="n">t</span> <span class="ow">in</span> <span class="nb">set</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">doc</span><span class="p">));</span><span class="n">avgdl</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="n">np</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">mean</span><span class="p">([</span><span class="nb">len</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">x</span><span class="p">)</span> <span class="k">for</span> <span class="n">x</span> <span class="ow">in</span> <span class="n">corpus</span><span class="p">]);</span><span class="n">tf</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="n">Counter</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">x</span><span class="p">)</span> <span class="k">for</span> <span class="n">x</span> <span class="ow">in</span> <span class="n">corpus</span><span class="p">]</span>
<span class="n">idx</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="p">{</span><span class="n">p</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="n">i</span> <span class="k">for</span> <span class="n">i</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="n">p</span> <span class="ow">in</span> <span class="nb">enumerate</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">products</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">product_id</span><span class="p">)}</span>
<span class="k">def</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf">bm25</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">q</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="n">product_id</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="n">k1</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="mf">1.5</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="n">b</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="mf">.75</span><span class="p">):</span>
 <span class="n">j</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="n">idx</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="n">product_id</span><span class="p">];</span><span class="n">dl</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="nb">len</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">corpus</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="n">j</span><span class="p">]);</span><span class="n">score</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="mf">0.</span>
 <span class="k">for</span> <span class="n">term</span> <span class="ow">in</span> <span class="n">toks</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">q</span><span class="p">):</span>
    <span class="n">nterm</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="n">docfreq</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="n">term</span><span class="p">];</span><span class="n">idf</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="n">np</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">log</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="mi">1</span><span class="o">+</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">D</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="n">nterm</span><span class="o">+</span><span class="mf">.5</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="o">/</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">nterm</span><span class="o">+</span><span class="mf">.5</span><span class="p">))</span>
    <span class="n">freq</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="n">tf</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="n">j</span><span class="p">][</span><span class="n">term</span><span class="p">];</span><span class="n">score</span><span class="o">+=</span><span class="n">idf</span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n">freq</span><span class="o">*</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">k1</span><span class="o">+</span><span class="mi">1</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="o">/</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">freq</span><span class="o">+</span><span class="n">k1</span><span class="o">*</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="mi">1</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="n">b</span><span class="o">+</span><span class="n">b</span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n">dl</span><span class="o">/</span><span class="n">avgdl</span><span class="p">))</span>
 <span class="k">return</span> <span class="n">score</span>
<span class="c1"># Feature construction: no future clicks, logged rank, or relevance is included.</span>
<span class="c1"># A domain glossary bridges synonymous e-commerce terms (e.g., computer/laptop).</span>
<span class="c1"># This is allowed at inference and never reads relevance or click labels.</span>
<span class="n">canonical</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="p">{</span><span class="n">word</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="n">cat</span> <span class="k">for</span> <span class="n">cat</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="n">words</span> <span class="ow">in</span> <span class="n">categories</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">items</span><span class="p">()</span> <span class="k">for</span> <span class="n">word</span> <span class="ow">in</span> <span class="n">words</span><span class="p">}</span>
<span class="k">def</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf">normalize_tokens</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">text</span><span class="p">):</span>
 <span class="k">return</span> <span class="p">[</span><span class="n">canonical</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">get</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">t</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="n">t</span><span class="p">)</span> <span class="k">for</span> <span class="n">t</span> <span class="ow">in</span> <span class="n">toks</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">text</span><span class="p">)]</span>
<span class="n">normalized_docs</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="n">normalize_tokens</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">t</span><span class="p">)</span> <span class="k">for</span> <span class="n">t</span> <span class="ow">in</span> <span class="n">products</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">title</span><span class="p">]</span>
<span class="n">normalized_tf</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="n">Counter</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">doc</span><span class="p">)</span> <span class="k">for</span> <span class="n">doc</span> <span class="ow">in</span> <span class="n">normalized_docs</span><span class="p">]</span>
<span class="n">normalized_df</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="n">Counter</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">t</span> <span class="k">for</span> <span class="n">doc</span> <span class="ow">in</span> <span class="n">normalized_docs</span> <span class="k">for</span> <span class="n">t</span> <span class="ow">in</span> <span class="nb">set</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">doc</span><span class="p">))</span>
<span class="n">normalized_avgdl</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="n">np</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">mean</span><span class="p">([</span><span class="nb">len</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">doc</span><span class="p">)</span> <span class="k">for</span> <span class="n">doc</span> <span class="ow">in</span> <span class="n">normalized_docs</span><span class="p">])</span>
<span class="k">def</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf">normalized_bm25</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">query</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="n">product_id</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="n">k1</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="mf">1.5</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="n">b</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="mf">.75</span><span class="p">):</span>
 <span class="n">j</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="n">idx</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="n">product_id</span><span class="p">]</span>
 <span class="n">length</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="nb">len</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">normalized_docs</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="n">j</span><span class="p">]);</span><span class="n">score</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="mf">0.</span>
 <span class="k">for</span> <span class="n">term</span> <span class="ow">in</span> <span class="n">normalize_tokens</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">query</span><span class="p">):</span>
  <span class="n">term_freq</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="n">normalized_tf</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="n">j</span><span class="p">][</span><span class="n">term</span><span class="p">]</span>
  <span class="n">freq</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="n">normalized_df</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="n">term</span><span class="p">]</span>
  <span class="n">idf</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="n">np</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">log</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="mi">1</span><span class="o">+</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">D</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="n">freq</span><span class="o">+</span><span class="mf">.5</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="o">/</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">freq</span><span class="o">+</span><span class="mf">.5</span><span class="p">))</span>
  <span class="n">score</span><span class="o">+=</span><span class="n">idf</span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n">term_freq</span><span class="o">*</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">k1</span><span class="o">+</span><span class="mi">1</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="o">/</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">term_freq</span><span class="o">+</span><span class="n">k1</span><span class="o">*</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="mi">1</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="n">b</span><span class="o">+</span><span class="n">b</span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n">length</span><span class="o">/</span><span class="n">normalized_avgdl</span><span class="p">))</span>
 <span class="k">return</span> <span class="n">score</span>
<span class="n">df</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s1">'bm25'</span><span class="p">]</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="n">bm25</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">q</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="n">p</span><span class="p">)</span> <span class="k">for</span> <span class="n">q</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="n">p</span> <span class="ow">in</span> <span class="nb">zip</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">df</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s1">'query'</span><span class="p">],</span><span class="n">df</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s1">'product'</span><span class="p">])]</span>
<span class="n">df</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s1">'normalized_bm25'</span><span class="p">]</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="n">normalized_bm25</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">q</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="n">p</span><span class="p">)</span> <span class="k">for</span> <span class="n">q</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="n">p</span> <span class="ow">in</span> <span class="nb">zip</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">df</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s1">'query'</span><span class="p">],</span><span class="n">df</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s1">'product'</span><span class="p">])]</span>
<span class="n">df</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s1">'word_overlap'</span><span class="p">]</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="nb">len</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="nb">set</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">toks</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">q</span><span class="p">))</span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="nb">set</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">toks</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">t</span><span class="p">)))</span> <span class="k">for</span> <span class="n">q</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="n">t</span> <span class="ow">in</span> <span class="nb">zip</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">df</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s1">'query'</span><span class="p">],</span><span class="n">df</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s1">'title'</span><span class="p">])]</span>
<span class="n">features</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s1">'bm25'</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="s1">'normalized_bm25'</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="s1">'word_overlap'</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="s1">'quality'</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="s1">'price'</span><span class="p">]</span>
<span class="nb">print</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">df</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="n">features</span><span class="o">+</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s1">'relevance'</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="s1">'click'</span><span class="p">]]</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">corr</span><span class="p">()</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">round</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="mi">2</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">to_string</span><span class="p">())</span>
</pre></div>
</div>
</div>
</div></details>
<div class="output_wrapper">

<div class="cell border-box-sizing text_cell rendered" id="cell-id=1cf1ff0b"><div class="inner_cell">
<div class="text_cell_render border-box-sizing rendered_html">
<h2 id="3.-Query-safe-train,-validation-and-test-split">3. Query-safe train, validation and test split</h2><p>Never split individual rows of the same query across train and test: that inflates offline ranking metrics. All query groups are held out as units.</p>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="cell border-box-sizing code_cell rendered" id="cell-id=34f33fec">
<details class="code-block"><summary>Python source · Cell 4</summary><div class="input">
<div class="inner_cell">
<div class="input_area">
<div class="highlight hl-ipython3"><pre><span></span><span class="c1"># Split by query so test queries never appear in model fitting.</span>
<span class="n">qids</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="n">np</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">array</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="nb">sorted</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">df</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">qid</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">unique</span><span class="p">()));</span><span class="n">trq</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="n">rest</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="n">train_test_split</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">qids</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="n">test_size</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="mf">.35</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="n">random_state</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="mi">42</span><span class="p">);</span><span class="n">vaq</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="n">teq</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="n">train_test_split</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">rest</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="n">test_size</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="mf">.5</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="n">random_state</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="mi">42</span><span class="p">)</span>
<span class="n">sets</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="p">{</span><span class="s1">'train'</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="n">df</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="n">df</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">qid</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">isin</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">trq</span><span class="p">)]</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">copy</span><span class="p">(),</span><span class="s1">'valid'</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="n">df</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="n">df</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">qid</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">isin</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">vaq</span><span class="p">)]</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">copy</span><span class="p">(),</span><span class="s1">'test'</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="n">df</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="n">df</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">qid</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">isin</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">teq</span><span class="p">)]</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">copy</span><span class="p">()}</span>
<span class="nb">print</span><span class="p">({</span><span class="n">x</span><span class="p">:(</span><span class="nb">len</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">v</span><span class="p">),</span><span class="n">v</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">qid</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">nunique</span><span class="p">())</span> <span class="k">for</span> <span class="n">x</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="n">v</span> <span class="ow">in</span> <span class="n">sets</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">items</span><span class="p">()})</span>
<span class="k">def</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf">mean_ndcg</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">frame</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="n">score_col</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="n">k</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="mi">10</span><span class="p">):</span>
 <span class="k">return</span> <span class="n">np</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">mean</span><span class="p">([</span><span class="n">ndcg_score</span><span class="p">([</span><span class="n">g</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">relevance</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">to_numpy</span><span class="p">()],[</span><span class="n">g</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="n">score_col</span><span class="p">]</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">to_numpy</span><span class="p">()],</span><span class="n">k</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="n">k</span><span class="p">)</span> <span class="k">for</span> <span class="n">_</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="n">g</span> <span class="ow">in</span> <span class="n">frame</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">groupby</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s1">'qid'</span><span class="p">)])</span>
<span class="nb">print</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s1">'Validation BM25 NDCG@10:'</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="nb">round</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">mean_ndcg</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">sets</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s1">'valid'</span><span class="p">],</span><span class="s1">'bm25'</span><span class="p">),</span><span class="mi">3</span><span class="p">))</span>
</pre></div>
</div>
</div>
</div></details>
<div class="output_wrapper">
<div class="output">
<div class="output_area">
<div class="output_subarea output_stream output_stdout output_text">
<pre>{'train': (4191, 136), 'valid': (1137, 37), 'test': (1138, 37)}
Validation BM25 NDCG@10: 0.616
</pre>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="cell border-box-sizing text_cell rendered" id="cell-id=6323ce28"><div class="inner_cell">
<div class="text_cell_render border-box-sizing rendered_html">
<h2 id="4.-Implement-pairwise-ranking-learning">4. Implement pairwise ranking learning</h2><p>For each query, take pairs with different relevance labels. The difference in document features is classified as a preference using Logistic Regression (RankNet-style pairwise logistic surrogate). We sample balanced forward/reverse pairs.</p>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="cell border-box-sizing code_cell rendered" id="cell-id=243bb5bc">
<details class="code-block"><summary>Python source · Cell 5</summary><div class="input">
<div class="inner_cell">
<div class="input_area">
<div class="highlight hl-ipython3"><pre><span></span><span class="c1"># Form within-query relevant-versus-irrelevant pairs and fit a ranking loss.</span>
<span class="k">def</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf">make_pairs</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">frame</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="n">seed</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="mi">7</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="n">cap</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="mi">40</span><span class="p">):</span>
 <span class="n">r</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="n">np</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">random</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">default_rng</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">seed</span><span class="p">);</span><span class="n">xx</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="p">[];</span><span class="n">yy</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="p">[]</span>
 <span class="k">for</span> <span class="n">_</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="n">g</span> <span class="ow">in</span> <span class="n">frame</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">groupby</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s1">'qid'</span><span class="p">):</span>
    <span class="n">good</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="n">g</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="n">g</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">relevance</span><span class="o">&gt;=</span><span class="mi">2</span><span class="p">];</span><span class="n">bad</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="n">g</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="n">g</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">relevance</span><span class="o">==</span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">]</span>
    <span class="k">for</span> <span class="n">_</span> <span class="ow">in</span> <span class="nb">range</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="nb">min</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">cap</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="nb">len</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">good</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="o">*</span><span class="nb">len</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">bad</span><span class="p">))):</span>
      <span class="n">a</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="n">good</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">iloc</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="nb">int</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">r</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">integers</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="nb">len</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">good</span><span class="p">)))][</span><span class="n">features</span><span class="p">]</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">to_numpy</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">dtype</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="nb">float</span><span class="p">)</span>
      <span class="n">b</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="n">bad</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">iloc</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="nb">int</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">r</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">integers</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="nb">len</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">bad</span><span class="p">)))][</span><span class="n">features</span><span class="p">]</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">to_numpy</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">dtype</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="nb">float</span><span class="p">)</span>
      <span class="n">xx</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">extend</span><span class="p">([</span><span class="n">a</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="n">b</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="n">b</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="n">a</span><span class="p">]);</span><span class="n">yy</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">extend</span><span class="p">([</span><span class="mi">1</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">])</span>
 <span class="k">return</span> <span class="n">np</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">array</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">xx</span><span class="p">),</span><span class="n">np</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">array</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">yy</span><span class="p">)</span>
<span class="n">scaler</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="n">StandardScaler</span><span class="p">()</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">fit</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">sets</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s1">'train'</span><span class="p">][</span><span class="n">features</span><span class="p">]);</span>
<span class="n">xpair</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="n">ypair</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="n">make_pairs</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">sets</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s1">'train'</span><span class="p">]);</span><span class="n">scale</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="n">scaler</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">scale_</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">copy</span><span class="p">();</span><span class="n">scale</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="n">scale</span><span class="o">==</span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">]</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="mi">1</span>
<span class="c1"># Scaling differences is equivalent to standardizing each document before subtraction.</span>
<span class="n">xpair</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="n">xpair</span><span class="o">/</span><span class="n">scale</span>
<span class="n">scores</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="p">[];</span><span class="n">rankers</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="p">{}</span>
<span class="k">for</span> <span class="n">C</span> <span class="ow">in</span> <span class="p">[</span><span class="mf">.03</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="mf">.3</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="mf">3.0</span><span class="p">]:</span>
    <span class="n">model</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="n">LogisticRegression</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">C</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="n">C</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="n">fit_intercept</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="kc">False</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="n">max_iter</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="mi">300</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">fit</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">xpair</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="n">ypair</span><span class="p">)</span>
    <span class="n">val</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="n">sets</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s1">'valid'</span><span class="p">]</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">copy</span><span class="p">();</span><span class="n">val</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s1">'rank_score'</span><span class="p">]</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="n">model</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">decision_function</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">scaler</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">transform</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">val</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="n">features</span><span class="p">]))</span>
    <span class="n">metric</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="n">mean_ndcg</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">val</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="s1">'rank_score'</span><span class="p">);</span><span class="n">scores</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">append</span><span class="p">((</span><span class="n">C</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="n">metric</span><span class="p">));</span><span class="n">rankers</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="n">C</span><span class="p">]</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="n">model</span>
<span class="n">bestC</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="nb">max</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">scores</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="n">key</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="k">lambda</span> <span class="n">x</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="n">x</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="mi">1</span><span class="p">])[</span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">]</span>
<span class="nb">print</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s1">'Validation grid:'</span><span class="p">,[(</span><span class="n">c</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="nb">round</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">s</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="mi">3</span><span class="p">))</span> <span class="k">for</span> <span class="n">c</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="n">s</span> <span class="ow">in</span> <span class="n">scores</span><span class="p">],</span><span class="s1">'best C'</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="n">bestC</span><span class="p">)</span>
</pre></div>
</div>
</div>
</div></details>
<div class="output_wrapper">
<div class="output">
<div class="output_area">
<div class="output_subarea output_stream output_stdout output_text">
<pre>Validation grid: [(0.03, np.float64(0.941)), (0.3, np.float64(0.924)), (3.0, np.float64(0.892))] best C 0.03
</pre>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="cell border-box-sizing text_cell rendered" id="cell-id=c494a228"><div class="inner_cell">
<div class="text_cell_render border-box-sizing rendered_html">
<h2 id="5.-Final-ranking-evaluation-and-error-analysis">5. Final ranking evaluation and error analysis</h2><p>We compare random, lexical retrieval, and a reranker using the <strong>untouched test query groups</strong>. A strong reranker can incorporate product quality even when BM25 keyword overlap is imperfect.</p>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="cell border-box-sizing code_cell rendered" id="cell-id=6599a942">
<details class="code-block"><summary>Python source · Cell 6</summary><div class="input">
<div class="inner_cell">
<div class="input_area">
<div class="highlight hl-ipython3"><pre><span></span><span class="c1"># Compare selected ranker to random and lexical retrieval on untouched queries.</span>
<span class="n">test</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="n">sets</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s1">'test'</span><span class="p">]</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">copy</span><span class="p">();</span><span class="n">test</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s1">'random_score'</span><span class="p">]</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="n">np</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">random</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">default_rng</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="mi">101</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">random</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="nb">len</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">test</span><span class="p">));</span><span class="n">test</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s1">'rank_score'</span><span class="p">]</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="n">rankers</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="n">bestC</span><span class="p">]</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">decision_function</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">scaler</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">transform</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">test</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="n">features</span><span class="p">]))</span>
<span class="n">metrics</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="p">{</span><span class="n">n</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="n">mean_ndcg</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">test</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="n">c</span><span class="p">)</span> <span class="k">for</span> <span class="n">n</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="n">c</span> <span class="ow">in</span> <span class="p">[(</span><span class="s1">'Random'</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="s1">'random_score'</span><span class="p">),(</span><span class="s1">'Raw BM25'</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="s1">'bm25'</span><span class="p">),(</span><span class="s1">'Synonym BM25'</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="s1">'normalized_bm25'</span><span class="p">),(</span><span class="s1">'Pairwise ranker'</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="s1">'rank_score'</span><span class="p">)]}</span>
<span class="nb">print</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s1">'Test NDCG@10:'</span><span class="p">,{</span><span class="n">k</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="nb">round</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">v</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="mi">3</span><span class="p">)</span> <span class="k">for</span> <span class="n">k</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="n">v</span> <span class="ow">in</span> <span class="n">metrics</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">items</span><span class="p">()})</span>
<span class="n">fig</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="n">ax</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="n">plt</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">subplots</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="mi">1</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="mi">2</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="n">figsize</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="mi">11</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="mf">3.5</span><span class="p">));</span><span class="n">ax</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">]</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">bar</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="nb">list</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">metrics</span><span class="p">),</span><span class="nb">list</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">metrics</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">values</span><span class="p">()));</span><span class="n">ax</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">]</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">set</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">ylabel</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="s1">'NDCG@10'</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="n">ylim</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="mi">1</span><span class="p">),</span><span class="n">title</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="s1">'Unseen-query ranking quality'</span><span class="p">);</span><span class="n">ax</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="mi">1</span><span class="p">]</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">bar</span><span class="p">([</span><span class="nb">str</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">c</span><span class="p">)</span> <span class="k">for</span> <span class="n">c</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="n">_</span> <span class="ow">in</span> <span class="n">scores</span><span class="p">],[</span><span class="n">s</span> <span class="k">for</span> <span class="n">_</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="n">s</span> <span class="ow">in</span> <div class="cell border-box-sizing text_cell rendered" id="cell-id=2bcb4f77"><div class="inner_cell">
<div class="text_cell_render border-box-sizing rendered_html">
<h2 id="What-the-results-mean-/-interview-discussion">What the results mean / interview discussion</h2><p>The split, loss, and metric operate at <strong>query level</strong>, not arbitrary rows. This pairwise scorer is a <em>reranker over a fixed candidate set</em>; large-scale retrieval would require an inverted index or vector index and a candidate recall evaluation. Click feedback contains position bias and must not be used as unconfounded relevance.</p>
<p><strong>Try explaining these without looking at the code:</strong></p>
<ol>
<li>Why does GroupKFold matter for ranking?</li>
<li>What is the difference between candidate recall and NDCG@10?</li>
<li>How would you correct position bias in real click logs?</li>
</ol>
<p><strong>Limitations and next step:</strong> Evaluate on a suitably licensed real-world dataset or stronger simulation with domain shift, logging bias and realistic selection. Never treat synthetic performance as production evidence.</p>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="cell border-box-sizing text_cell rendered" id="cell-id=bdf382b5"><div class="inner_cell">
<div class="text_cell_render border-box-sizing rendered_html">
<h2 id="What-this-project-demonstrates,-and-what-it-does-not">What this project demonstrates, and what it does not</h2><p><strong>Next:</strong> compare LambdaMART, add explicit click propensity estimation, evaluate rare/unseen intents and measure retrieval latency. A ranking model can lose to a good lexical baseline—never assume complexity guarantees improvement.</p>
<p><strong>Reproduce:</strong> <code>Run All</code> in Jupyter; no private or uploaded data required. For real data, use leakage-safe train/validation/test partitions and respect each dataset license.</p>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="cell border-box-sizing text_cell rendered" id="cell-id=56d58306"><div class="inner_cell">
<div class="text_cell_render border-box-sizing rendered_html">
<h3 id="Search-failure-analysis">Search failure analysis</h3><p>Look at a held-out query where the raw BM25 score is zero for a semantically relevant document (e.g., <em>computer</em> versus <em>notebook</em>). Synonym-normalized retrieval can repair this lexical mismatch. A learned pairwise ranker <strong>may</strong> still underperform a strong lexical baseline on a small synthetic dataset; that is a result, not a test failure.</p>
</div>
